scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run patch:test-runtime && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/type-tool-desktop.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/stroke-options.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/context-menus-pointer-parity.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/tool-drawer.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/import-3d.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/paint-bucket-mouse.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/iphone-mini.spec.js --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/file-open-desktop.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/toolbar-submenu-desktop.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --reporter=line && playwright test tests/e2e/value-entry-desktop.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --reporter=line && npm run test:e2e:touch
scripts.test:e2e:touch: npm run patch:test-runtime && playwright test tests/e2e/touch --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:touch:chromium: npm run patch:test-runtime && playwright test tests/e2e/touch --project='touch-*' --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:touch:webkit: npm run patch:test-runtime && playwright test tests/e2e/touch --project='webkit-*' --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:touch:journeys:ledger: npm run patch:test-runtime && rm -rf test-results/journey-ledger && JOURNEY_LEDGER_WRITE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/touch/journeys.spec.js --project=touch-ipad-portrait --project=touch-ipad-landscape --project=touch-iphone-portrait --project=touch-iphone-landscape --project='webkit-*' --reporter=dot; node tests/e2e/touch/merge-ledger.js
scripts.test:visual: npm run patch:test-runtime && vitest run tests/visual
scripts.test:visual:screenshots: npm run patch:test-runtime && ENABLE_SCREENSHOT_VISUALS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.js
scripts.test:perf: npm run patch:test-runtime && vitest run tests/perf
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:coverage: npm run patch:test-runtime && node scripts/run-vitest.js run --coverage
scripts.test:update: npm run patch:test-runtime && VECTURA_UPDATE_BASELINES=1 npm run test:visual
scripts.hooks:install: HOOKS_DIR="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-commit "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-push "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push" && chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push"
